description: Generate a CycloneDX v1.5 SBOM for a project. Discovers all dependencies (direct + transitive) from lock files and manifests across Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java. Use verbosity='minimal' for counts, 'compact' (default) for component list, 'full' for complete CycloneDX JSON.

output_path.description: Path to write SBOM file. Absent = no write, present = write to that path.

name: sbom_generate
